name: Test-output blocking confirmation
aliases: switchgear Switchgear test and commissioning interfaces
summary: Confirms that the assigned operating output block is present before a test initiation.
description: Confirms that the assigned operating output block is present before a test initiation. A test interface separates measurement, command and indication paths so their behavior can be checked in the documented test configuration. The test boundary must show which real equipment outputs remain enabled.

In a switchgear relay panel, test links can separate a protective relay from the trip coils while maintaining the specified current-transformer secondary arrangement. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Output-block feedback” at the input and “Block-confirmed status” at the output. A software block and physical isolation differ.

Trace the source and destination on each side of the test boundary. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
